effects: Anyone who submits the signature through castVoteBySig casts the signer's vote on proposalId, while that proposal is Active.
The vote direction is support: 0 = Against, 1 = For, 2 = Abstain. Any other value reverts.
The signer's whole voting weight goes to that side: their delegated ENS votes at the proposal's snapshot block (getVotes(account, voteStart)).
The signer is marked as having voted, so they cannot vote again on this proposal. The signature has no nonce or deadline, so it stays valid until it is used or the voting period ends.
No tokens, ETH or approvals move.
formats.shown: "Cast vote on ENS governance proposal" with the proposal id as a raw 77-digit number and the vote as For / Against / Abstain.

findings.title: Ballot: the intent leaves out the vote direction and the proposal; no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Ballot: "intent": "Cast vote on ENS governance proposal", with no interpolatedIntent. The direction (support) is only in the 'Vote' field.

findings.title: Ballot: the proposal id is a 256-bit hash shown raw, so the signer cannot tell which proposal it is.
findings.evidence: Governor.sol hashProposal: proposalId = keccak256(targets, values, calldatas, descriptionHash). descriptor field 'Proposal id' format raw. Case 0 shows 65124996456969240058970412761127463646733711243818620698023168930879474320148.
findings.fix: No descriptor format can turn the hash into a title. The wallet or the dApp has to show the proposal title.

findings.title: Ballot: the voting weight committed is read from storage and not shown.
findings.evidence: Governor.sol _castVote: uint256 weight = getVotes(account, proposal.voteStart.getDeadline()); _countVote(...weight). Ballot carries only proposalId and support.

findings.title: Ballot: the signature has no nonce or deadline, so anyone can relay it at any time while voting is open.
findings.evidence: Governor.sol: BALLOT_TYPEHASH = keccak256("Ballot(uint256 proposalId,uint8 support)"); castVoteBySig recovers the voter and calls _castVote. Only hasVoted in GovernorCountingSimple._countVote stops it from being used twice.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. A label or note could say the vote is final once submitted.
